lines.zh: 我小跑着，尾巴在身后甩成一杆旗。
lines.en: I trot, my tail swinging like a flag behind me.

lines.zh: 腿短，可是步子快得很。
lines.en: My legs are short, but my steps are quick.

lines.zh: 我沿着平原的草缝穿过去。
lines.en: I thread my way through the seams of the plain.

lines.zh: 成群走才安心，我贴着同伴的侧身。
lines.en: Walking in a herd calms me, so I hug my neighbour's flank.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边低头啃两口草。
lines.en: I walk and snatch two bites of grass as I go.

lines.zh: 耳边的风一响，我就加快半步。
lines.en: A whisper of wind and I hurry half a step.

lines.zh: 我踩过浅水，脚下一阵凉。
lines.en: I cross the shallows and my feet go cold.

lines.zh: 尾巴先探进灌木，我才跟进去。
lines.en: My tail probes the shrub before I follow it in.

lines.zh: 抬头看一眼天，我继续往前走。
lines.en: I glance up at the sky and keep walking.

lines.zh: 同伴拐弯，我也跟着拐。
lines.en: My herd turns and I turn with it.

lines.zh: 草地很宽，我走出一条小路。
lines.en: The meadow is wide and I wear a narrow path.

lines.zh: 我蹦过一道小沟，落地很轻。
lines.en: I hop a little ditch and land lightly.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，尽量不显眼。
lines.en: I keep low to the ground and try not to stand out.

lines.zh: 一阵急走之后，我停下来喘气。
lines.en: After a burst of walking I stop to catch my breath.

lines.zh: 身后的草被压出一条细线。
lines.en: The grass behind me is pressed into a thin line.

lines.zh: 我小心绕开那块松动的石头。
lines.en: I carefully skirt the loose stone.

lines.zh: 清晨的露水打湿了我的脚。
lines.en: Morning dew soaks my feet.

lines.zh: 我们一群小跑过整片草原。
lines.en: We small ones trot across the whole grassland.

lines.zh: 我站定，耳朵还在转来转去。
lines.en: I stand still, but my ears keep swivelling.

lines.zh: 草丛一动，我就抬头看一看。
lines.en: Grass stirs and I lift my head to look.

lines.zh: 我把重心放在后腿上，随时能跑。
lines.en: My weight rests on my hind legs, ready to run.

lines.zh: 风把气味带来，我慢慢闻。
lines.en: The wind brings scents and I sniff them slowly.

lines.zh: 我抖抖尾巴，又安静下来。
lines.en: I flick my tail and go quiet again.

lines.zh: 阳光刚好，我站着打个盹。
lines.en: The sun is just right and I doze standing up.

lines.zh: 有只小虫爬上来，我甩了甩腿。
lines.en: A small bug climbs me and I shake my leg.

lines.zh: 我盯着远处那棵树，看了很久。
lines.en: I stare at that distant tree for a long while.

lines.zh: 站得久了，我换了个方向。
lines.en: Standing too long, I turn a different way.

lines.zh: 我轻轻咀嚼，嘴里还留着草。
lines.en: I chew faintly, grass still in my mouth.

lines.zh: 同伴叫了一声，我回了个短音。
lines.en: A herdmate calls and I answer with a short note.

lines.zh: 我把脖子伸出去听地面。
lines.en: I stretch my neck down to listen to the ground.

lines.zh: 四周太静了，我有点紧张。
lines.en: It is too quiet around me and I grow tense.

lines.zh: 我半蹲下来，让腿歇一歇。
lines.en: I half crouch to rest my legs.

lines.zh: 尾尖敲着地面，一下又一下。
lines.en: My tail tip taps the ground, again and again.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩进草浪里。
lines.en: I tuck myself into the waves of grass.

lines.zh: 我仰头看你，脖子伸得老长。
lines.en: I crane my neck up at you.

lines.zh: 你一动，我就跟着抖一下。
lines.en: Each time you move, I twitch.

lines.zh: 我往后退了半步，又忍不住看你。
lines.en: I back off half a step and still cannot stop watching.

lines.zh: 你的影子压过来，我压低了头。
lines.en: Your shadow slides over me and I duck my head.

lines.zh: 我侧着脑袋，猜你要做什么。
lines.en: I tilt my head, guessing what you will do.

lines.zh: 你没有靠太近，我才没跑。
lines.en: You keep your distance, so I stay.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，那里最可能动。
lines.en: I watch your hands; that is where motion starts.

lines.zh: 我发出一声轻叫，试探你。
lines.en: I give a light call to test you.

lines.zh: 你这么高，草都藏不住你。
lines.en: You are so tall the grass cannot hide you.

lines.zh: 我看了看你，又看看逃跑的方向。
lines.en: I glance at you, then at my escape route.

lines.zh: 我们互相打量，谁也没动。
lines.en: We size each other up and neither moves.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨了下眼，还是没走。
lines.en: I blink slowly and still do not leave.

lines.zh: 我尖叫一声，窜出好几步。
lines.en: I squeal and bolt several strides.

lines.zh: 我疼得蜷进草丛里。
lines.en: The pain curls me up into the grass.

lines.zh: 这一下让我腿一软，差点跪下。
lines.en: It buckles my legs and I nearly kneel.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，眼睛乱看。
lines.en: I curl up and my eyes dart.

lines.zh: 血沾在草上，我看见了。
lines.en: Blood on the grass, and I can see it.

lines.zh: 我边跑边回头，怕它再打。
lines.en: I run and keep looking back for another blow.

lines.zh: 痛从背上一直传到后腿。
lines.en: The ache runs from my back down to my hind legs.

lines.zh: 我拼命蹬地，想站得稳些。
lines.en: I dig in hard to steady myself.

lines.zh: 我发出一声很长的哀叫。
lines.en: I let out a long, wavering cry.

lines.zh: 这么打下去，我撑不了多久。
lines.en: At this rate I cannot last much longer.

lines.zh: 你一抖那束草，我就挪过去了。
lines.en: Shake that bundle of grass and I move in.

lines.zh: 嫩芽的味道让我抬起了头。
lines.en: The smell of young shoots lifts my head.

lines.zh: 我小步快跑，眼睛黏在草上。
lines.en: I break into a quick trot, eyes stuck on the grass.

lines.zh: 这东西比我脚下的甜。
lines.en: This tastes sweeter than what grows underfoot.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，凑到你手底下。
lines.en: I stretch my neck under your hand.

lines.zh: 我一边吃，一边看着你的另一只手。
lines.en: I eat while watching your other hand.

lines.zh: 你能再给一点吗，我还饿。
lines.en: Could you give a little more? I am still hungry.

lines.zh: 我把整束草都拽下来了。
lines.en: I drag down the entire bundle.

lines.zh: 我嚼得很快，怕你收回去。
lines.en: I chew fast in case you take it back.

lines.zh: 有吃的，我连警觉都忘了。
lines.en: With food, I forget even to be wary.

lines.zh: 我跟在你脚边，就为这口草。
lines.en: I trail at your feet for just this grass.

lines.zh: 叶尖还挂着，我踮脚去够。
lines.en: A leaf tip dangles and I rise to reach it.

lines.zh: 我嘴里含着草，尾巴摇得更欢。
lines.en: Grass in mouth, my tail swings faster.

lines.zh: 这一口下去，我可以再走一段了。
lines.en: With this mouthful I can walk another stretch.

lines.zh: 我吃完抬头看你，等你再给。
lines.en: Finished, I look up and wait for more.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我跟着走一步。
lines.en: You take a step and I take a step.

lines.zh: 我被撞得一歪，赶紧找平衡。
lines.en: The bump tips me and I scramble for balance.

lines.zh: 你这么一挤，我整只都滑开了。
lines.en: That shove slides me sideways.

lines.zh: 我吓了一跳，尾巴先翘起来。
lines.en: I startle and my tail pops up first.

lines.zh: 腿太细，我差点就被撞倒。
lines.en: My legs are thin and I nearly go over.

lines.zh: 我从你腿边钻过去，贴着草走。
lines.en: I slip past your leg, hugging the grass.

lines.zh: 我们撞上时，我听见自己尖叫。
lines.en: When we collide, I hear myself squeak.

lines.zh: 站稳之后，我回头看你一眼。
lines.en: Once steady, I look back at you.

lines.zh: 让让路，我要绕过去。
lines.en: Make way; I want to get around.

lines.zh: 草太密，我们才撞到一起。
lines.en: The grass is thick, which is how we met.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖被撞乱的毛。
lines.en: I shake out my rumpled fur.

lines.zh: 我们鼻子碰鼻子，很快又分开。
lines.en: We touch noses and part just as quickly.

lines.zh: 它追我跑，绕着草丛转了两圈。
lines.en: It chases me twice around the grass.

lines.zh: 我替它咬着尾巴上的草屑。
lines.en: I pull grass bits from its tail.

lines.zh: 我们并排低头，吃同一片草。
lines.en: We lower our heads side by side over one patch.

lines.zh: 它一叫，我就朝它那边靠。
lines.en: When it calls, I lean toward it.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一块暖地上打盹。
lines.en: We doze crowded on one warm patch.

lines.zh: 我追着它跑，跑得气都喘不上。
lines.en: I chase it until I am out of breath.

lines.zh: 它的尾尖扫过我的脸。
lines.en: Its tail tip brushes my face.

lines.zh: 我们一前一后，绕开那块石头。
lines.en: We go one behind the other, around the stone.

lines.zh: 它停下，我也停下，隔着半步。
lines.en: It stops, and I stop half a step away.

lines.zh: 我叼起一片落叶，嚼了两下。
lines.en: I pick up a fallen leaf and chew twice.

lines.zh: 我捡了颗小石子，又丢掉了。
lines.en: I pick up a pebble and drop it again.

lines.zh: 草茎太硬，我咬断半截。
lines.en: The stem is tough, so I bite it in half.

lines.zh: 我低头把种子衔在嘴里。
lines.en: I dip down and carry seeds in my mouth.

lines.zh: 有块果皮，我闻了闻才吃。
lines.en: A bit of fruit skin; I sniff it before eating.

lines.zh: 我把东西含在颊边，慢慢磨。
lines.en: I hold it in my cheek and grind it slowly.

lines.zh: 我叼着草跑回同伴那里。
lines.en: I carry the grass back to my herd.

lines.zh: 这个咬不动，我吐了出来。
lines.en: I cannot bite through this, so I spit it out.

lines.zh: 我捡起一小截嫩枝，很满意。
lines.en: I pick up a short tender twig, well pleased.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞满了，我还在找。
lines.en: My mouth is full and I am still looking.

lines.zh: 草丛突然一分，我立刻绷住。
lines.en: The grass parts and I freeze taut.

lines.zh: 那东西的个头不小，我盯着它。
lines.en: That thing is big, and I lock my eyes on it.

lines.zh: 我先发出一声短促的警报。
lines.en: I sound a short alarm first.

lines.zh: 我锁定了它的腿，那里最慢。
lines.en: I fix on its legs; they are the slowest part.

lines.zh: 气味不对，我把头压低。
lines.en: The scent is wrong, so I lower my head.

lines.zh: 同伴四散，我却先看清了它。
lines.en: My herd scatters, but I see it clearly first.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就知道要糟。
lines.en: The way it moves tells me this is bad.

lines.zh: 我挑了个能跑的方向再盯它。
lines.en: I pick a line of escape, then stare at it.

lines.zh: 心跳快得厉害，我没有退。
lines.en: My heart races and I do not retreat.

lines.zh: 我朝它低鸣，声音在发抖。
lines.en: I call at it, and my voice shakes.

lines.zh: 我跟着它移动，始终留出距离。
lines.en: I track its movement and keep my distance.

lines.zh: 它往左，我往右，绕开正面。
lines.en: It goes left, I go right, avoiding its front.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，尾巴一直抖。
lines.en: I stare at it and my tail keeps twitching.

lines.zh: 它进一步，我就退一步。
lines.en: It takes a step and I give one.

lines.zh: 我数着它的脚步，不敢眨眼。
lines.en: I count its footsteps and dare not blink.

lines.zh: 我们绕着同一块空地转圈。
lines.en: We circle the same patch of clearing.

lines.zh: 它停下，我也停下不动。
lines.en: It halts, and I hold still.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，藏进草里。
lines.en: I crouch low and hide in the grass.

lines.zh: 我眼睛不眨，怕漏掉一下。
lines.en: I do not blink for fear of missing a move.

lines.zh: 同伴在远处叫，我没有回头。
lines.en: A herdmate calls far off and I do not look away.

lines.zh: 我冲上去咬住它的脚踝。
lines.en: I dash in and bite its ankle.

lines.zh: 我用头一顶，撞在它小腿上。
lines.en: I butt my head into its shin.

lines.zh: 尾巴抽过去，声音很脆。
lines.en: My tail whips over with a sharp crack.

lines.zh: 我咬一口就退，不敢久留。
lines.en: I bite once and retreat; I dare not linger.

lines.zh: 它转身，我趁机再咬一下。
lines.en: It turns, and I snatch another bite.

lines.zh: 我跳起来撞它的侧面。
lines.en: I leap and slam into its flank.

lines.zh: 腿蹬得飞快，我绕着它打。
lines.en: My legs churn as I strike around it.

lines.zh: 这一口咬空了，我赶紧退开。
lines.en: This bite misses and I scramble back.

lines.zh: 我一边叫一边往前扑。
lines.en: I call out as I lunge forward.

lines.zh: 打完我喘得厉害，站都晃。
lines.en: After the fight I pant hard and sway.

lines.zh: 我从草丛里钻出来，四下张望。
lines.en: I push out of the grass and look around.

lines.zh: 平原的风刮过，我抖了抖毛。
lines.en: Wind crosses the plain and I shake my coat.

lines.zh: 一群同伴跟在我后头，脚步杂乱。
lines.en: A herd follows behind me, feet in a clatter.

lines.zh: 这是片新草原，草很高。
lines.en: This is a new grassland, and the grass is tall.

lines.zh: 我先低头啃了一口，试试味道。
lines.en: I take a bite first to test the taste.

lines.zh: 阳光有点刺眼，我眯起眼睛。
lines.en: The sun is bright and I squint.

lines.zh: 远处有东西在动，我先藏进草里。
lines.en: Something stirs far off, so I hide in the grass.

lines.zh: 我从白垩纪的平原一路跑到这。
lines.en: I have run here all the way from a Cretaceous plain.

lines.zh: 这地方草多，藏着也容易。
lines.en: Plenty of grass here, easy to hide in.

lines.zh: 我听见同伴的叫声，朝那边去。
lines.en: I hear my herd calling and head that way.

lines.zh: 落脚之前，我先绕了一圈。
lines.en: Before settling, I circle once.

lines.zh: 小跑几步，我确认四周没什么。
lines.en: A few trotting steps and I confirm it is clear.

lines.zh: 火烫到毛尖，我跳着躲开。
lines.en: Fire singes my fur and I leap away.

lines.zh: 落地时我滚了半圈，膝盖发疼。
lines.en: I roll half a turn on landing and my knees ache.

lines.zh: 水没过头顶，我拼命蹬腿。
lines.en: Water closes over me and I kick desperately.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀飞，草屑糊了满脸。
lines.en: The blast throws me and grass bits cake my face.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西扎进后腿，我跳起来。
lines.en: Something sharp stabs my hind leg and I spring up.

lines.zh: 一股看不见的力捏住我，我挣不开。
lines.en: An unseen force grips me and I cannot pull free.

lines.zh: 太饿了，我连站起来的力气都没。
lines.en: Too hungry to even stand up.

lines.zh: 雷落下，我四腿一僵，尾巴冒烟。
lines.en: Lightning falls and my legs lock, tail smoking.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有了，我直直掉下去。
lines.en: Nothing underfoot, and I drop straight down.
